title: Add-On Price List for VPS and Dedicated Servers: Backups, Managed Support, Control Panel
content:
Three monthly add-ons can sit on a server in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range: automatic daily backups, managed support and a control panel licence. Whether each can be added, and what it costs per month, depends on the tier.

## Automatic daily backups

| Tier | Backup add-on can be added | Price, percent of the server's monthly price | Days daily backups are kept |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | Yes | 20 | 7 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | Yes | 20 | 7 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | Yes | 20 | 7 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | Yes | 20 | 7 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | No | 20 | 7 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | No | 20 | 7 |

The backup add-on is priced as a percentage of the server's own monthly price rather than as a fixed amount. The two Harborline Dedicated tiers carry the same percentage and retention figures in the schedule, but the add-on cannot be added to them.

## Managed support and control panel licence

| Tier | Managed support can be added | Managed support, price per month (USD) | Managed support requires a supported control panel licence on the server | Control panel licence, price per month (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | No | 0.00 | Yes | 19.99 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | Yes | 30.00 | Yes | 19.99 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | Yes | 30.00 | Yes | 29.99 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | Yes | 30.00 | Yes | 29.99 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | Yes | 50.00 | Yes | 49.99 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | Yes | 50.00 | Yes | 49.99 |

The managed support price is shown as 0.00 where the add-on is unavailable, which on this list is Harborline VPS 2 GB only.

## Reading the list

- **Monthly price of backups on a hypothetical server priced at 70.00 per month:** 20 percent of 70.00, which is 14.00 per month. The figure 70.00 is an illustrative input, not a Harborline price.
- **A tier where both managed support and the licence are taken:** on every tier where managed support can be added, the licence is required with it, so the two monthly prices are paid together; on Harborline VPS 4 GB, for example, that is 30.00 for managed support and 19.99 for the licence.
